title: Claude response is empty with stop_reason max_tokens and no error
symptoms: stop_reason: max_tokens with zero text blocks
A report or document arrives blank
cause: max_tokens covers thinking as well as the visible answer. On a busy prompt the model can spend the whole budget thinking and return no text.
fix: Raise max_tokens well above the expected answer length, log stop_reason, and treat empty text or stop_reason max_tokens as a failed attempt that retries with a larger budget.
